fan_letter.title: The Apology Tour Begins
fan_letter.body: After {namedGameName}, the mailbag is not angry so much as wounded. Fans want to know the room understands what slipped away.

beat_column.title: Column: The Loss That Lingers
beat_column.body: {namedGameName} is becoming the shorthand for every old doubt about this franchise. The next answer has to come on the field.

owner_email.title: Owner Email: Explain the Plan
owner_email.body: I do not need theater after {namedGameName}. I need a clear response from the football operation and a team that looks prepared next week.

resolution_resolved.title: Recovery Logged
resolution_resolved.body: The response after {namedGameName} landed. One win does not erase it, but the room stopped the story from becoming a spiral.

resolution_escalated.title: Pressure Escalates
resolution_escalated.body: The follow-up to {namedGameName} only deepened the questions. The apology tour is now a pressure campaign.
